channel.title: Kay Du — New Malaysia Hiking Trails & Free GPX Files
channel.description: New hiking trails, free GPX downloads and outdoor stories from Kay Du's 60 Mountains Challenge across Malaysia.

item.title: New trail #21: Broga Hill — Semenyih, Selangor (Free GPX)
item.description: Broga Hill, Semenyih — Moderate, 4.6 km, 459 m elevation gain, 402 m peak. Permit required. Free GPX trail file, meeting point and route notes now on kayducreator.com.

item.title: New story: Refreshing Langkawi — A 4-Day Itinerary (Gastronomy, Culture & Heritage)
item.description: 4 days in Langkawi with Tourism Malaysia — Ro-Ro ferry from Kuala Perlis, island hopping at Dayang Bunting and Beras Basah, the SkyCab and Eagle's Nest SkyBridge, Gua Pinang on the Kubang Badak BioGeoTrail, and a 44-photo gallery.

item.title: New trail #20: Gunung Kerunai — Gerik, Perak (Free GPX)
item.description: Gunung Kerunai, Gerik — Moderate, 4.6 km, 707 m elevation gain, 911 m peak. Permit and mountain guide required (night hike). Free GPX trail file on kayducreator.com.

item.title: New trail #19: Bukit Gasing — Petaling Jaya, Selangor (Free GPX)
item.description: Bukit Gasing, Petaling Jaya — Easy, 4.8 km, 329 m elevation gain, 155 m peak. Free GPX trail file on kayducreator.com.

item.title: New trail #18: Rawang Bypass — Rawang, Selangor (Free GPX)
item.description: Rawang Bypass viewpoint — Easy, 2.8 km, 158 m elevation gain, 220 m peak. Free GPX trail file on kayducreator.com.

item.title: New trail #17: Jeram Perlus — Hulu Langat, Selangor (Free GPX)
item.description: Jeram Perlus waterfall trail, Hulu Langat — Slightly Hard, 15.8 km, 820 m elevation gain. Permit required. Free GPX trail file on kayducreator.com.

item.title: New trail #16: Bukit Desa Damai — Bentong, Pahang (Free GPX)
